title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On Aug. 3 in a Cypress neighborhood, Harris County sheriff's deputies stopped two 19-year-olds, Anthony and Julian, after mistaking their Camaro for a stolen car. Deputies drew guns, handcuffed them, and at least five patrol cars and a helicopter were involved. The sheriff's office said license plate cameras had flagged a stolen Camaro linked to aggravated robberies. An undercover unit saw a matching car, but deputies and the helicopter could not read its plates, so backup was called. After the men were handcuffed, deputies realized it was the wrong car.

Anthony's mother, Leslie, said she plans to hire an attorney and wants deputies held accountable. The sheriff's office said supervisors, including the district captain, shift lieutenants, and shift sergeants, will review body-worn camera footage to check whether procedures were followed. The men were given information on filing a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
